|strategy=By [mailto:photog@visi.net Mark Schaffer], Gold 41<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/tightsqueeze.html</ref>

I couldn't believe how helpless I felt the first time this was played on my [[Dark Deal]] deck at [[Bespin: Cloud City]]. "If you have a lone vehicle or starfighter in a battle or [[Attack Run]] at [[Beggar]]'s Canyon, Cloud City, [[Death Star: Trench]] or an asteroid sector, use 1 Force. At the end of that battle or [[Attack Run]], opponent must forfeit two participating vehicles or starfighters."

No matter what happens in the battle, the Dark Side player must lose two participating vehicles or starfighters. So, [[Obsidian 7]] and 8 are gone or two Cloud Cars and their pilots! The Light Side player doesn't even need a destiny to inflict heavy casualties on the Dark Side. This will really put the squeeze on your opponent's Cloud City Scenario Deck!
